Name: Pastel Sam
Author: hiddlecutie
Description:
I finally decided to go back to my Sam mod (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1483), which I wasn't happy about anymore, and made him completely pastel this time! 

[u]Changes:
[/u]
♥ Pink hair
♥ Pastel scheme for his clothes 
♥ Changed his formal attire to a white suit 
♥ No more holes in his hoodie!
♥ Added a septum piercing
♥ Heterochromia 
♥ His skateboard is pastel too! 

[u]Installation:[/u]
Drop the contents of the .zip archive into your Content folder! SMAPI not required.

Notes:
I have NOT changed his work AND flower dance attire. Both his portrait and character spires were modified. This mod was made live on my Twitch channel. I do pastel reworks on request there. ♥
